Tent X1 — Three-Season Backpacking Tent

The Tent X1 is a three-season, two-person backpacking tent designed for weekend explorers who need reliable weatherproofing without extra pack weight. It uses a fast-pitch aluminum frame that sets up in under four minutes, even in wind or rain, and it is priced at $249.00.

Specifications

Packed weight is 3.1 pounds, floor area is 29 square feet, and the rainfly carries a 3000mm waterproof rating. The Tent X1 ships with a repair kit, guy lines, and a compression sack, and it is covered by Acme Gear's two-year repair-or-replace warranty described on our about page.

Buy the Tent X1

The Tent X1 is in stock and ships within two business days from our Denver, Colorado warehouse.
